title: Publish quarterly treasury transparency report and enable on-chain audit dashboard
description:
# Publish quarterly treasury transparency report and enable on-chain audit dashboard

This proposal directs the DAO to publish a quarterly treasury transparency report and stand up a public, read-only on-chain audit dashboard so all stAMOR holders can independently verify reserves and flows. The change is reversible: the dashboard is a read-only viewer and the reporting cadence can be amended or sunset by a later vote. No treasury funds are moved by this proposal; it only mandates disclosure and adds visibility for smaller holders. A 90-day pilot is proposed, after which the DAO reviews and may continue, adjust, or discontinue.

impact.nativeMagnitude: no funds moved; reporting + read-only dashboard
